replication.target_description: Non-preregistered exploratory chi-squared comparison of rejection-moderation versus combined control conditions, located on p. 15.

n.sample_role: Participants across rejection-moderation and both combined control conditions after exploratory exclusions.
n.exclusions: Exploratory analyses exclude participants agreeing to either first request: 19 in rejection-moderation and 43 in equivalent-request control. The printed final sample of 391 applies before the additional equivalent-request exclusions.

notes: Identity verified from title page: title and all seven authors match the supplied Genschow et al. reference; DOI 10.1037/pspa0000261 is printed. The source is a 26-page author manuscript bearing an APA 2020 accepted-manuscript notice, not the copy of record; it contains Method, Results, Discussion, and References. No PDF was supplied. Only n_r is assigned; all other fields are unassigned placeholders. The p. 15 locator identifies the exploratory combined-control comparison (printed χ2 = 24.64, p < .001), following removal of first-request compliers. A distinct preregistered combined-control comparison appears on p. 14 (χ2 = 10.82, p = .001) and uses the printed overall final N = 391; it is retained here as a separate candidate, not merged with the p. 15 test. The exploratory test N and mutually exclusive final arm counts are not printed. A subtraction from 391 would be required, whereas the assigned rule authorizes analytic N sums only from explicit mutually exclusive final groups. No N is reconstructed. No calculation performed: 391 is the preregistered overall final sample, and 43 is an additional exploratory exclusion count, not a final group count eligible for summing.
